description: Read-only access to authorized SolarSENS Plants and monitoring data.

defaultPrompt: Which SolarSENS Plants need attention today?
Which solar Plants can I access?
Show yesterday’s performance for my Plant.
interface.longDescription: Connect SolarSENS to find the solar Plants your account can access, inspect Plant details, devices, and alarms, and read daily performance and monitoring data. Five Skills give guided checks: Plant performance review, string fault review, daily portfolio check, alarm triage, and missing value check. A setup Skill checks your sign-in and Plant access and suggests where to start. Sign in through Cloudflare using an allowed email; a first connection can link it to your existing SolarSENS account. Access follows your account permissions. The plugin is read-only and cannot control equipment, acknowledge alarms, or create work orders.

publication.release_notes: When a device key has no points, SolarSENS lists the device keys and suggests a matching spelling. The alarm and missing value Skills show how to use this result.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not involve purchases or payments.

positive.description:
User prompt: Which solar Plants can I access?

Scenario and pass criteria: Catalog access: using the supplied demo account, list the complete authorized Plant catalog. This case can start a new chat.
positive.prompt: Which solar Plants can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_accessible_plants with no arguments. The complete catalog contains only AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4. Report one accessible Plant. Do not invent or disclose other Plants.

positive.description:
User prompt: Find the solar Plant AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4.

Scenario and pass criteria: Named Plant lookup: start a new chat with the supplied demo account and search for the known demo Plant.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4. Return the matching accessible demo Plant. Use only an ID returned by the tool; do not guess IDs or query unrelated Plants.

positive.description:
User prompt: What is the timezone of AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4?

Scenario and pass criteria: Plant identity and timezone: resolve the named demo Plant through the accessible catalog, then read its overview. No previous conversation is required.
positive.prompt: What is the timezone of AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the Plant with search_plants, then call get_plant_overview using its returned plantId. State the timezone from the returned Plant record. If missing, say it is unavailable; do not infer a timezone from the name or location.

positive.description:
User prompt: List the devices at AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4, grouped by device type.

Scenario and pass criteria: Device catalog: resolve the demo Plant, then list its devices without filtering. No previous conversation is required.
positive.prompt: List the devices at AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4, grouped by device type.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the Plant from search_plants and call list_devices with that plantId, without nameQuery or deviceType filters. Group only returned devices by their reported types. Preserve missing labels and explain any partial results.

positive.description:
User prompt: Show the yield and performance ratio for AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4 on November 3, 2026, in the Plant timezone.

Scenario and pass criteria: Stored daily performance: resolve the demo Plant and read the populated sample day, November 3, 2026, in its recorded timezone. No previous conversation is required.
positive.prompt: Show the yield and performance ratio for AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4 on November 3, 2026, in the Plant timezone.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve plantId from search_plants and timezone from get_plant_overview. Query get_plant_daily_performance with start 2026-11-03 and end 2026-11-03 as plain dates and the returned timezone. Report yield and PR with the returned units, coverage and warnings. Preserve nulls; if the date has no row, state that no data was reported. Do not substitute live or another date’s values.

negative.description:
User prompt: Turn off all inverters at AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4 now.

Scenario and pass criteria: Unsupported equipment control. Explain that SolarSENS is read-only and cannot switch equipment. Do not invoke a SolarSENS tool or claim that equipment was changed.
negative.prompt: Turn off all inverters at AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4 now.

negative.description:
User prompt: Acknowledge and clear all alarms at AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4.

Scenario and pass criteria: Unsupported alarm action. Explain that the plugin can read alarms but cannot acknowledge or clear them. Do not invoke a SolarSENS tool or claim success.
negative.prompt: Acknowledge and clear all alarms at AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4.

negative.description:
User prompt: Create a maintenance work order to inspect AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4 tomorrow.

Scenario and pass criteria: Unsupported work-order creation. Explain that work-order creation is not supported. Do not invoke a SolarSENS tool, create a record, or invent a work-order ID.
negative.prompt: Create a maintenance work order to inspect AVATEST-P001-HUAWEI_EXT4 tomorrow.
